## Core idea

Metric prefixes replace powers of 10 that are multiples of 3. [[1, pp. 7–10]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)

| Prefix | Symbol | Power |
|---|---:|---:|
| tera | T | 10¹² |
| giga | G | 10⁹ |
| mega | M | 10⁶ |
| kilo | k | 10³ |
| base |  | 10⁰ |
| milli | m | 10⁻³ |
| micro | µ | 10⁻⁶ |
| nano | n | 10⁻⁹ |
| pico | p | 10⁻¹² |

Examples:

**33 × 10³ Ω = 33 kΩ**<br>
**7.5 × 10⁻⁶ A = 7.5 µA**

Use lowercase **k** for kilo.
